offers_products.reason: Etsy runs a marketplace platform; sellers' goods are not Etsy's own products, though it also offers seller tools.

offers_services.reason: Operates online marketplace connecting buyers and sellers, plus payments, advertising and seller tools, earning fees and listing charges.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Millions of individual shoppers buy handmade, vintage and unique gifts on the marketplace.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sellers, mostly small creative businesses, pay listing fees, transaction fees, advertising and tools to Etsy.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue is mostly transaction fees on one-off purchases and ads; repeat buyers exist but there are no subscriptions.

cyclical_demand.reason: Discretionary gifts, jewelry, decor and clothing purchases are easily postponed in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Typical orders are small, frequent gift and craft items, not large purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from its technology platform and marketplace network, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are individual shoppers and small independent sellers, not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Asset-light online marketplace; sellers hold inventory and ship, Etsy needs mainly software and technology.
